core_insights: PnL 公式不是 accuracy 代理 — 是 magnitude × correctness − fee。Round-trip cost ≈ 2bp。短 horizon 净边际 3bp,长 horizon 净边际 8bp。长 horizon 在数学上有 2-3× 更宽的安全边际。
score=max-over-5-horizons 是服务器替你做模型选择 → 集中火力优化 1-2 个 best-bet horizon (押 h=40 / h=60),其他 horizon 当免费保险。
决策阶段 (τ 调优) 与模型阶段同等重要,但 effort/return 高一到两个数量级。 大多数 baseline 用 argmax / 固定 τ 直接放弃 50% PnL。
5 stocks 太少使 OOD novel sym 是 first-class 风险:必须 sym-agnostic 表征 (per-window normalization, LOSO CV, sym-dropout augmentation)。
stateless + shuffled batch + 100-tick window 把序列问题 reduce 成 i.i.d. supervised learning,完美匹配 GBDT, 但 1D-CNN 能补 GBDT 错过的 lag-cross-correlation。

top10.name: GBDT regression on Δmp/mp_t with weighted MSE (w=|Δ|^0.5), per-horizon 独立 model
top10.rationale_key: PnL 在 magnitude 上线性 → regression 比 3-class CE 更 PnL-aligned; magnitude weighting 让 loss 关心交易上重要的样本

top10.name: 2D τ-grid search (τ_up, τ_down) on LOSO holdout, per-horizon 独立
top10.rationale_key: fee=2bp 在阈值处不可微,argmax / fixed τ 直接放弃 30-50% PnL; 不需要新模型 / 新特征

top10.name: 手工特征 ~500 维 + time-of-day (分钟号 / session phase / AM-PM)
top10.rationale_key: data 已重度预处理,手工 + GBDT 是 Pareto 最优; time-of-day 是 free alpha 但常被忘

top10.name: LOSO 5-fold × 3-seed GBDT ensemble (mean predict)
top10.rationale_key: OOD 泛化 + 阈值方差 reduce; 每 sym 各 hold 一次=cv+ensemble 一举两得

top10.name: Stage 2 PnL fine-tune: 用 stage 1 regression r̂ 作 init,再用 PnL surrogate fine-tune
top10.rationale_key: 纯 PnL loss 直接训会失败 (gradient 病态),两阶段 init 把它 stable 化,直对齐 objective

top10.name: 3-class CE auxiliary head (multi-task,权重 0.1)
top10.rationale_key: CE 在 |Δ|≈α 边界给 anchor + confidence calibration; 主 regression + 辅 CE 互补

top10.name: per-horizon, per-fold τ 选取 + holdout 二次验证
top10.rationale_key: 防 τ 过拟合 holdout — 把 holdout 50/50 切, 前半选 τ 后半验证

top10.name: 1D-CNN on raw 100×D window 作 stacking 第二模型,在 LOSO holdout 选 blend weight
top10.rationale_key: GBDT 完全忽略时序结构,CNN 抓 lag-cross-correlation 提供 model-class diversity

top10.name: Sym-dropout augmentation: 训练时 25% sample 视为 unknown sym (通过 z-score scale jitter)
top10.rationale_key: OOD insurance, 强迫 model 仅用窗口信号; 边际效果但 cheap

top10.name: Window length augmentation: 训练时随机用 80-100 ticks
top10.rationale_key: 鲁棒性 + 轻微 ensemble 效果, 几乎零成本

top10.name: Quantile regression: 同时预测 Q25/Q50/Q75, 决策 require Q25>fee 或 Q75<-fee (高置信门槛)
top10.rationale_key: PnL 关心 magnitude+置信; quantile 直接给置信区间, 高置信 τ 更稳

top10.name: Order flow regime feature: 100-tick abs return std → volatility regime conditioning
top10.rationale_key: volatility 是 HFT 公认重要 conditioning, 让 model 学 regime-specific signal

top10.name: Cross-horizon stacking: 用 horizon-5 r̂ 作 horizon-60 model 的额外特征 (vice versa)
top10.rationale_key: 不同 horizon 抓不同尺度信号, 简单 stacking 提供 micro-/meso-scale 互补

high_risk_high_reward.name: HRHR-1: End-to-end PnL maximization with Gumbel-Softmax discrete decision
high_risk_high_reward.potential: +10-15% PnL if converged; 0 or worse if collapses to no-trade
high_risk_high_reward.rationale_key: Unify model+decision into single optimization,从根本上 attack post-hoc τ 的 sub-optimality

high_risk_high_reward.name: HRHR-2: Adversarial domain training — sym classifier head with reverse gradient
high_risk_high_reward.potential: +20 PnL on novel sym subset; or main loss 退化
high_risk_high_reward.rationale_key: OOD novel sym 是题面 first-class 风险,直接 attack 风险源

high_risk_high_reward.name: HRHR-3: Self-supervised pretraining on next-tick prediction (BERT-style masked)
high_risk_high_reward.potential: +15-25 PnL upper bound; or pretrain 不 transfer
high_risk_high_reward.rationale_key: 用全部 2.4M ticks 学 universal microstructure dynamics, 预训 trunk 后 fine-tune horizon heads

high_risk_high_reward.name: HRHR-4: Bayesian queue dynamics hardcoded model (Cont 2014-style)
high_risk_high_reward.rationale_key: 机制性模型 universal,极强 OOD 泛化, 在 novel sym 上稳吃 GBDT

high_risk_high_reward.name: HRHR-5: Trade-size / position-aware fee saving (smooth 连续同向预测)
high_risk_high_reward.potential: +15-30% fee saving cumulative; 或与官方公式冲突
high_risk_high_reward.rationale_key: 连续 5-10 tick 同向 trade 节省 ~80% 中间 fee, 但需先验证评测公式合规性

key_design_choices_summary.target: Δmp/mp_t 连续回归 (主) + 3-class CE (辅, multi-task)
key_design_choices_summary.loss: weighted MSE (w=|Δ|^0.5) + 0.1× CE; stage 2 用 PnL surrogate fine-tune
key_design_choices_summary.feature_pipeline: ~500 手工特征 + time-of-day + raw 100×D (CNN 用)
key_design_choices_summary.normalization: log1p (volume/intst) + per-window z-score; 价/return 不 normalize; indicator 严格保留
key_design_choices_summary.augmentation: sym-shuffle / window-crop / LOB-level-mask; 不用 Gaussian / MixUp / time-reversal
key_design_choices_summary.training: 5 LOSO folds × 3 seeds × 5 horizons; mean predict
key_design_choices_summary.threshold: 2D (τ_up, τ_down) grid search on LOSO holdout, 每 horizon 独立
key_design_choices_summary.multi_horizon: 5 个独立单 horizon 模型,提交全 5 个让服务器取 max
key_design_choices_summary.ood_sym: LOSO CV + sym-agnostic 特征 + sym-dropout augmentation
key_design_choices_summary.calibration: 通过 τ 调优隐式做; 不单独 isotonic / Platt
key_design_choices_summary.early_stopping: validation PnL (after τ-grid) 作主 metric; F1_macro 备用
key_design_choices_summary.submission: 5 horizons 全填 (免费保险); 算力优先级 h=40 > h=60 > h=20 > h=10/5

highest_leverage_single_trick: 在 LOSO holdout 上做 2D (τ_up, τ_down) grid search 取代 argmax / fixed τ — 不需要新模型/特征/代码, 但在 fee=2bp 的 sharp boundary 下能改写排行榜 (估计 +30-50% PnL)
